faqs.q: Do I need to know how to use Google Analytics?
faqs.a: No. That is the point. We pull the numbers from Google Search Console and Google Analytics for you and write them up in plain language you can read fast.

faqs.q: How often will I get a report?
faqs.a: The standard is a clear weekly report, delivered automatically. If you would rather have it at another rhythm, we can set it to what suits you.

faqs.q: What is actually in the report?
faqs.a: The searches your site shows up for, how many clicks you get, your top pages, and how your traffic is trending. We keep it to what matters and skip the noise.

faqs.q: Can you report on more than one website?
faqs.a: Yes. The same setup works across sites, so if you run more than one, each gets its own clear report without extra manual effort.
